Ondas is building exposure across autonomous drones, counter-drone technology and defense electronics. Now I’m interested in delivery schedules, margins and how efficiently these orders translate into revenue.

items.title: AI stocks sold off Thursday after OpenAI disclosed annualized revenue of approximately $50 billion at the end of September, below the widely
items.content_excerpt: AI stocks sold off Thursday after OpenAI disclosed annualized revenue of approximately $50 billion at the end of September, below the widely reported $68 billion figure. The higher estimate included gross revenue from partners, according to a person familiar with the matter. Despite the discrepancy, OpenAI reported 77% growth in its total revenue run rate during Q3 and 107% growth in its enterprise business. Shares of Nvidia fell 3%, Oracle nearly 6% and CoreWeave almost 8%, while AMD and Broadcom dropped 4% each, Intel lost 5% and Super Micro Computer declined nearly 5%. The revenue clarification raised concerns about AI valuations and the financial performance of companies benefiting from massive AI infrastructure spending. OpenAI faces pressure to justify its $852 billion valuation as it prepares for a potential 2027 IPO. $NVDA $ORCL $CRWV $AMD

items.content_excerpt: Apple will hold a product-launch event in New York on October 13, titled “Welcome Home,” to unveil a new smart-home lineup under CEO John Ternus, who took over last month. The centerpiece is a smart-home hub featuring a roughly 6-inch square display that can be placed on a table or mounted on a wall. The device will use Siri AI and a built-in camera and voice recognition to identify household members and deliver personalized content. The lineup is also expected to include an upgraded Apple TV 4K and a refreshed HomePod mini, with support for Apple’s latest AI capabilities. The hub will integrate apps such as Calendar, Messages, Photos, FaceTime, Notes, Reminders, Music and Podcasts, alongside interactive photo displays and a clock interface. According to Bloomberg, Apple has partnered with LG Electronics to develop smart-home accessories, including a video doorbell, thermostat and indoor security camera. $AAPL

items.title: The Trump administration suspended several technology companies from the Permanent Labor Certification Program, including Microsoft, Cogniza
items.content_excerpt: The Trump administration suspended several technology companies from the Permanent Labor Certification Program, including Microsoft, Cognizant, Infosys, Tata, Wipro, HCL Technologies and Capgemini, accusing them of widespread abuse of the immigration system. Vice President JD Vance said the suspensions would remain indefinite until the administration’s concerns were addressed, while Labor Secretary Keith Sonderling confirmed that multiple federal investigations are underway. The program allows US employers to sponsor foreign workers for permanent residency. Vance alleged that companies made fundamentally illegitimate and illegal statements in their applications and urged technology firms to prioritize hiring and training American workers, specifically criticizing Microsoft and Adobe. The move follows broader efforts by President Donald Trump to tighten legal and illegal immigration restrictions, including tougher rules for H-1B visas. $MSFT $ADBE $CTSH

items.content_excerpt: Google, owned by Alphabet, launched a new Gemini AI agent designed to function as a virtual coworker, intensifying competition with OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft for enterprise customers. The tool operates across Gmail, Drive, Docs and Calendar, supporting tasks ranging from answering questions and generating content to programming. Unlike traditional chatbots, the agent has its own corporate identity and can pursue objectives over several days rather than simply responding to prompts or completing predefined tasks within a single application. Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said the agent can select the best AI model for each task and includes built-in cost controls, security, administration and governance features tailored to businesses. The launch aims to accelerate corporate adoption and help Google monetize hundreds of billions of dollars in AI infrastructure investments through enterprise contracts. $GOOGL $MSFT

The new tablets feature faster processors, higher-resolution displays, sturdier aluminum designs and AI-powered Alexa capabilities. A new “On-Screen Intelligence” feature allows users to ask Alexa to analyze screen content, shop for products shown in videos, add events to calendars and perform other tasks. items.title: Meta has begun banning paid advertising from ByteDance, TikTok’s Chinese parent company, across its platforms in the US, Canada, Egypt, Indo
items.content_excerpt: Meta has begun banning paid advertising from ByteDance, TikTok’s Chinese parent company, across its platforms in the US, Canada, Egypt, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand and Vietnam, escalating competition between the social media giants. The restrictions also apply to third-party advertisers running campaigns linked to TikTok and other ByteDance properties. Meta spokesperson Chris Sgro said the company would not accept ads from a competitor seeking to divert users away from its apps, describing the move as a standard business practice. The dispute intensified after Meta reached an $18 billion agreement with US states in August requiring stronger child-safety protections across Instagram and Facebook. Meta has since pressured TikTok and YouTube to implement comparable measures, arguing that online child-safety concerns affect the entire industry and cannot be addressed by one company alone. $META

items.content_excerpt: Google, owned by Alphabet, launched a new Gemini AI agent designed to function as a virtual coworker, intensifying competition with OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft for enterprise customers. The tool operates across Gmail, Drive, Docs and Calendar, supporting tasks ranging from answering questions and generating content to programming. Unlike traditional chatbots, the agent has its own corporate identity and can pursue objectives over several days rather than simply responding to prompts or completing predefined tasks within a single application. Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian said the agent can select the best AI model for each task and includes built-in cost controls, security, administration and governance features tailored to businesses. The launch aims to accelerate corporate adoption and help Google monetize hundreds of billions of dollars in AI infrastructure investments through enterprise contracts. $GOOGL $MSFT

The service runs on Visa’s payment network and Checkout. com’s infrastructure. Moomoo U.S. CEO Neil McDonald said investors increasingly expect the same speed and convenience from investment platforms that they experience with other digital financial services. items.title: $GOOGL The OpenAI revenue “miss” that sank the AI trade today is mostly an accounting mismatch. The FT reports OpenAI told investors its ann
items.content_excerpt: $GOOGL The OpenAI revenue “miss” that sank the AI trade today is mostly an accounting mismatch. The FT reports OpenAI told investors its annualized revenue is approaching 50 billion, about 20 billion below the 70 previously suggested. The reason: Anthropic includes sales made through its cloud partners in its run rate. OpenAI excludes third-party cloud-channel sales. So part of the gap between OpenAI’s number and Anthropic’s reported expected 100 billion annualized run rate lives on someone else’s books: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure. Futurum’s Shay Boloor put it plainly: the winner of the AI model race keeps looking like whoever owns the distribution toll booth. The tape: Nasdaq down 1.4 percent, the chip index off 4.2. Google’s cloud business is one of the channels in Anthropic’s number.

items.title: $RKLB Neutron just got its clearest third-party endorsement yet. ARK Invest analysts Tasha Keeney and Daniel Maguire say Neutron's plann
items.content_excerpt: $RKLB Neutron just got its clearest third-party endorsement yet. ARK Invest analysts Tasha Keeney and Daniel Maguire say Neutron's planned 13,000 kg payload capacity comes close to Falcon 9's roughly 17,000 kg in a partially reusable configuration, with delivery to the launch pad targeted for Q4 this year. The more interesting read is the demand side. ARK says satellite operators are in "dire need" of launch access, and SpaceX's own Starlink V3 and upcoming StarMind satellites could deepen that shortage by soaking up internal capacity. In other words, Neutron does not need to beat Falcon 9. It needs to be close enough to sell every slot. Kepler has already booked a dedicated mission, no earlier than 2028. Shares added 1 percent overnight after falling 5 percent to 68.40 on Thursday. Tracking pad delivery next.

items.title: $ASTS GREAT NEWS FOR ASTS INVESTORS: SpaceX holds no satellites in orbit yet, launches start late 2027, and full commercial service won'
items.content_excerpt: $ASTS GREAT NEWS FOR ASTS INVESTORS: SpaceX holds no satellites in orbit yet, launches start late 2027, and full commercial service won't arrive until 2035 at the earliest. SpaceX has a license and spectrum, but the constellation has no satellites in orbit yet, and the service has no price or subscribers. Launches begin in late 2027. The acquired bands can't be used commercially until the EchoStar deal's later stage closes, which is expected by Nov 30, 2027. Half the constellation must be in orbit by Oct 7, 2032, and all of it by Oct 7, 2035. SpaceX claims the network "will deliver 5G speeds of up to 150Mbps per user," far faster than its current direct-to-cell satellites. But satellite beams share capacity across wide areas, so per-user speed under real load is unproven.

AI stocks sold off Thursday after OpenAI disclosed annualized revenue of approximately $50 billion at the end of September, below the widely reported $68 billion figure. The higher estimate included gross revenue from partners, according to a person familiar with the matter. Despite the discrepancy, OpenAI reported 77% growth in its total revenue run rate during Q3 and 107% growth in its enterprise business. Shares of Nvidia fell 3%, Oracle nearly 6% and CoreWeave almost 8%, while AMD and Broadcom dropped 4% each, Intel lost 5% and Super Micro Computer declined nearly 5%. The revenue clarification raised concerns about AI valuations and the financial performance of companies benefiting from massive AI infrastructure spending. OpenAI faces pressure to justify its $852 billion valuation as it prepares for a potential 2027 IPO. $NVDA $ORCL $CRWV $AMD

$ASTS: Yesterday, AST SpaceMobile and Starlink were competing to win Mobile Network Operator partnerships globally—a race AST was already winning, with more than 60 MNO partners representing over 3 billion subscribers. $ASTS ASTS Retail Traders Turn Bullish After SpaceX Earnings. Traders argued that SpaceX's move from carrier partner to potential competitor could increase demand for ASTS as an independent satellite alternative. https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/asts-retail-traders-turn-bullish-020212344.html Unlike SpaceX, AST SpaceMobile does not sell directly to consumers. It provides satellite coverage through carriers' existing spectrum and networks, allowing subscribers to connect with unmodified smartphones outside terrestrial coverage while carriers retain their customer relationships. AST has nearly 60 mobile-network partners covering more than 3 billion subscribers and over $1.2 billion in contracted commercial revenue commitments. SpaceX wants to create a "true mobile service."However, doing so would require upgraded satellites, additional spectrum and access to thousands of cell sites, which would be a costly expansion that could take years. AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile have ruled out renting their networks to SpaceX.

$ASTS Global Approvals, Expansion, Near Launches! https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/ast-spacemobile-asts-secures-global-131042154.html Analysts expect its revenue to surge from $71 million in 2025 to $150-$200 million in 2026 to 1 billion in 2027. They also expect its adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization to turn positive in 2027 and more than triple to $1.85 billion in 2028 ASTS has acquired a fourth manufacturing site in Midland, Texas and now operates over 500,000 square feet of manufacturing space globally. 32 additional next-generation satellites are currently in advanced stages of assembly, with goals for a high-cadence launch schedule to achieve continuous service "AST SpaceMobile is accelerating manufacturing, regulatory progress, commercial partnerships, and government programs, furthering its position as the only technology positioned to capture the massive direct to device broadband opportunity in full," commented Abel Avellan, AST SpaceMobile’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

$ASTS Why is T-Mobile leaving Starlink to partner with AT&T and Verizon to use AST satellite technology? Starlink acknowledged that AST SpaceMobile is its number 1 competitor. Here is why: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/ast-spacemobile-asts-could-benefit-115256977.html While Star will keep putting more satellites in orbit, there is one hiccup to getting Starlink internet: the terminals. To use Starlink, customers need to buy a terminal that serves as an antenna to receive high-speed satellite internet. AST SpaceMobile is the first satellite constellation capable of delivering high-speed internet directly to ALL mobile devices without an antenna or special hardware. How? Through ultra-large arrays and other patent innovations in satellite technologies. AST SpaceMobile aims to provide full cellphone service, including call, text, data, and live video streaming at faster speeds than any competitor.
$ASTS yet again becoming indispensable to all MNOs worldwide

$ASTS AT&T, Verizon back $1.2B broadband bet in space tech leader AST SpaceMobile The technology ASTS is building could change how every smartphone on the planet connects to the internet. https://finance.yahoo.com/sectors/technology/articles/t-verizon-back-1-2b-231700165.html AT&T and Verizon are among nearly 60 global mobile network operators that have collectively committed more than $1.2 billion in contracted revenue to AST SpaceMobile's growing satellite broadband network. The list of partners includes Vodafone, Rakuten, Bell Canada, Telus, and Saudi Telecom Company, which are also in the mix, covering a combined subscriber base of over three billion people worldwide. Think about the last time your phone lost a signal. Maybe it was on a road trip through a rural stretch of land, or mid-hike somewhere off the grid.
